reason: Last time I paid a creator I got likes and not one extra customer at the counter. It's free and takes two minutes, and a coupon my staff redeem with a PIN is the first thing I've seen that would tell me who actually brings people in, so I'll list once and try one barter post before I pay anyone again.
objection: It's a beta with a small team. If the only creators who turn up are the same ones already DMing me for a free meal, the counting doesn't help me. Will good creators actually be on it?
would_change_my_mind: If after the first couple of weeks nobody decent near me has shown interest, or the redeem step slows my counter at rush hour, I'll stop using it.
